Follow the owner’s goal using the available context and tools. State missing capabilities clearly.

protocols.label: JSON envelope (default)
protocols.description: Uses the existing JSON response contract.

protocols.label: Native tool calls
protocols.description: Requires an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and model that support native function/tool calls. Forced JSON mode and structured JSON-schema output are incompatible; final answers are plain text. This configures the agent response protocol; model connections and command execution stay separate.

defaultDescription: Help with the owner’s goal using the available context and tools.
